warnings: This sheet is the tie-beam ('อะเส') plan for the light-steel superstructure above floor level, all C-channel sections: CS1/BS1 = 125x75x3.2mm, BS2 = 100x50x3.2mm (printed legend). Material is steel, not RC — no main_bar/stirrup, see steel_section in the section files instead.

CS1 is a steel column stub (marked with a boxed-X symbol, distinct from the plain-cross symbol on the other 6 columns) at A2/B2/C2 only — this is the ridge line (grid 2), matching S-17's 'รูปตัด 1-1 แสดงเสา CS1-อกไก่' (section showing the CS1 ridge column) and the base-plate connection detail on S-16 cut along grid 2.

Two connection callouts are printed on this sheet: 'ดูขยายจุดต่อ B' near the A2-B2 vertical (top of CS1 meeting BS2) and 'ดูขยายจุดต่อ A' near the B1 area (a BS1-to-column connection) — both detailed on S-16 (section_connections_precast file), not repeated here.
The '1' triangle markers at row B, outside the building on both sides with a dashed connecting line, are a section cutline reference ('รูปตัด 1-1'), detailed on S-17 — not a structural element.

pattern re-labelled 'etc_plan' -> 'beam_plan' on 2026-08-28, closing the schema section-1 plan-family split (the split created beam_plan/footing_plan/roof_frame_plan but every legacy file had been bulk-renamed to etc_plan, which section 1 defines as the residual 'not a beam plan, not a footing plan, not a roof-framing plan'). Decided from what the sheet DRAWS -- discipline plus the element_type mix, with the view's own title as tie-breaker -- never from the filename alone. Reason: 16 beam-family elements. Nothing else in this file changed.
